item.title: Success Story | Khaled Hamidi – From Adversity to the Summit
item.description:
In June 2025 Dr. Musab Al-Shebib — a Syrian researcher and academic — chose engineer Khaled Hamidi to inaugurate his new “Success Stories” series.
The recorded conversation traces Khaled’s path from shattered classrooms in Syria, through the hurdles of life as a refugee in Türkiye, to graduating first in Mechatronics Engineering at Karabuk University’s Faculty of Technology.

Key moments covered in the interview:

  • Growing up amid conflict and studying under the roar of war-planes rather than school bells.
  • Crossing into Türkiye with little more than determination — and hundreds of unanswered questions.
  • Overcoming the language barrier, mastering Turkish, and turning exile into motivation rather than limitation.
  • Achieving rank #1 in Karabuk University’s Faculty of Technology (Mechatronics).

“Khaled refused to be just a statistic on a refugee list; instead, he became number one on the list of excellence.” — Dr. Musab Al-Shebib

Below is the full video interview as published on Dr. Al-Shebib’s Facebook page.

Turkish Summary | Bir Başarı Hikayesi

Zorlukların arttığı bir dönemde, Halid Hamidi’nin hikâyesi en ilham verici örneklerden biri oldu.
Suriye’de savaş ortamında eğitimine başlayan Halid, Türkiye’ye sığınmacı olarak geldi.
Türkçeyi kısa sürede öğrenerek Karabük Üniversitesi Mekatronik Mühendisliği bölümünde birinci olmayı başardı.
Bu sadece bir diploma değil; azmin ve iradenin zaferidir.

Message to readers: Circumstances can be harsher than imagined, yet steadfast willpower ultimately prevails.

item.title: Started Master’s Studies at Gaziantep University
item.description:
Khaled HAMIDI has officially embarked on a new academic journey by joining the Master’s program in Aerospace Engineering at Gaziantep University.

This step marks a strategic move to deepen his expertise in aerodynamics, spacecraft systems, and computational modeling—laying the groundwork for advanced interdisciplinary research and real-world innovation.

He expressed gratitude to those who supported his path, emphasizing that this milestone is not a destination, but a launchpad toward impactful research and future contributions in the aerospace field.

item.title: التخرج بمرتبة الشرف العليا
item.description: وَكَانَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيمًا الحمد لله الذي ما ختم جهد إلا بعونه ولا تم سعي إلا بفضله وتوفيقه، سبحان الذي بفضله وعطائه تتحقق الإنجازات، وبنوره وهدايته تستنير الطرقات. سبحان الذي إذا أعطَى أدهشَ بالعطاء. أحمد الله تعالى أن وفقني لإكمال دراستي وأن أكرمني بتخرجي وأنا في السنة الثالثة وبمرتبة الشرف العليا. لم يكن هذا النجاح وليد اللحظة، ولكنه حصيلة الجد والاجتهاد والكد والتعب. أهدي نجاح وتفوقي إلى من لا يضاهيهما أحد في الكون، إلى من أمرنا الله ببرّهما، إلى أمي وأبي، اللذان وقفا بجانبي طوال رحلتي دون كلل أو ملل. لقد كنتم نعم السند والعون في تحقيق هذا الحلم. أسأل الله أن يجزيكم خير الجزاء وأن يحفظكم بحفظه وكرمه. كما أود أن أعبر عن شكري وتقديري العميق لإخوتي وأهلي وأقربائي وأساتذتي، ولكل من كان له عون في نجاحي. لقد كان دعمهم وتشجيعهم أساساً لتحقيق هذا الإنجاز الكبير. وأيضاً، أتوجه بالشكر الخاص إلى أصدقائي الأعزاء الذين شاركوني فرحتي وساندوني خلال مسيرتي. اللهم لا تحرمني طموحاً أسمو إليه، واجعلني يا رب نافعًا لأمتي، واجعل كل أعمالي خالصة لوجهك الكريم. جامعة كارابوك، كلية التكنولوجيا، هندسة الميكاترونكس،

item.title: Launch of Robotech Creative Tech Community
item.description:
Overview

In a bold step reflecting Robotech Team’s mission to empower youth and advance technical skills, the Robotech Creative Tech Community was launched as an open, collaborative space for learning and sharing knowledge in robotics, AI, and modern technologies.

What Does the Community Offer?

  • 🔧 Specialized Technical Workshops: Covering areas such as robotics programming, system design, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
  • 🤝 Project & Tool Sharing: A collaborative environment to exchange tools, resources, and receive constructive feedback.
  • 💬 Interactive Discussions: A forum for sharing expertise and addressing technical challenges and ideas.
  • ❓ Ask an Expert: A dedicated channel for technical inquiries in programming, engineering, and computer science.
  • 💡 Innovation Platform: Practical support for transforming technical ideas into real-world projects.
  • 🛠️ Engineering Solutions: Technical consultations to improve mechanical and electronic performance in project development.

item.title: Launch of Robotech Team
item.description:
About the Initiative

In April 2021, engineer Khaled HAMIDI founded the Robotech Team, a youth-led initiative aimed at empowering university students in northern Syria and advancing education through technology.
The team was launched in response to the urgent need for an effective training environment that integrates practical technology with modern educational practices.

Team Objectives

Robotech focuses on:

  • Enhancing leadership and creative thinking among students.
  • Utilizing technology to improve educational outcomes.
  • Building a training platform that includes virtual classrooms and activity tracking.
